definitions.explanation: a substance applied to surfaces to reduce friction and wear
something that makes interactions, processes, or relationships run more smoothly

examples.japanese: {機械|きかい}に{潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}を{塗|ぬ}る。
ドアがきしむので{潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}を{差|さ}した。
examples.english: The door was squeaking, so I applied lubricant.

examples.japanese: {定期的|ていきてき}に{潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}を{補充|ほじゅう}しないと、{部品|ぶひん}が{摩耗|まもう}してしまう。
examples.english: If you don't replenish the lubricant regularly, the parts will wear out.

examples.japanese: ユーモアは{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}の{潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}だ。
お{酒|さけ}はコミュニケーションの{潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}になることがある。
examples.english: Alcohol can serve as a social lubricant.

examples.japanese: {雑談|ざつだん}は{職場|しょくば}の{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}において{大切|たいせつ}な{潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}の{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たしている。
examples.english: Casual conversation plays an important role as a social lubricant in workplace relationships.

notes:
Composed of {潤滑|じゅんかつ} (lubrication; smoothness) + {剤|ざい} (agent; preparation). The literal meaning is straightforward — a substance that reduces friction. The figurative meaning, especially in the phrase {人間関係|にんげんかんけい}の{潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}, is commonly encountered in Japanese essays and conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}を{塗|ぬ}る: to apply lubricant
- {潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}を{差|さ}す: to apply lubricant (to hinges, etc.)
- {潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}の{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす: to serve as a lubricant
- {人間関係|にんげんかんけい}の{潤滑剤|じゅんかつざい}: social lubricant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {潤滑油|じゅんかつゆ}: lubricating oil — specifically an oil-based lubricant
- グリス: grease — loanword for thick, paste-like lubricant
- {潤滑|じゅんかつ}: lubrication — the base noun describing the process
